Done. `state.lastSent` Map, key → `at` of last delivery; repeat within <5 min dropped.

Replay: 99 dropped (the flap repeats, all +2 min), 0 errors.

Two calls I made — say if either is wrong:
- Queue delivery during quiet hours counts as "sent", so it starts the 5-minute window.
- Window measured from last *delivery*, not last event, so back-to-back repeats can't extend it forever.
